owner_statement: A visually attractive buyer-growth creative was rejected as TOO WORDY; the simplified version was strongly preferred. Advertising should be understood extremely quickly. Do not explain the entire product in one advertisement. ONE PRIMARY IDEA · ONE STRONG HEADLINE · SHORT SUPPORT · ONE CTA. Additional visual information must earn its space. Distribute extra messages across campaign waves.

FEED_FAST.note: the Owner's stated preference; the Director tries this profile FIRST for feed placements

slots: navy band (3 items + one script phrase)
conditions: exactly one headline ≥ 2.2× any other text
every block in its fixed slot; no free-floating extra lines
no words on merchandise except ONE script accent phrase that carries no claim
no more than one script accent
ACQUISITION_RICH.evidence: REF-14/15/18–21 — the Owner's Gold/approved acquisition set runs 8–9 blocks in fixed slots; the rejected buyer creative was wordier than REF-18

EVENT.note: 3P.1 GENERAL(5)/LOGISTICS(7) preserved; WHEN is mandatory for a real event

slots: lot number + item name (from lot record)
catalogue size (only if true at generation and re-verified at publish)

rules.one_idea: a headline carries one idea; two-beat headlines ('Bid Today. Discover Tomorrow.') are one idea with two beats; a headline that lists benefits is two ideas → reject
rules.earn_its_space: each additional block must be a distinct fact/benefit; duplicates (a benefit row repeating a band item) are removed; the buyer 'too wordy' rejection is the anchor
rules.waves: the Marketing Director assigns extra messages to LAUNCH / MID / FINAL creatives instead of adding blocks
rules.claims: any block that promises an outcome, a fee level, a size or a speed is a claim → A2 claim manifest with production truth or it is removed
rules.readability_test: judge at feed proxy: 'What is this ad asking me to do, in one sentence?' must be answered from the headline + CTA alone

scorer.hard: blocks > profile ceiling; two headline-class elements; a benefit list in the headline
scorer.soft: text_region_pct above the profile band (FEED_FAST ≤ 14, ACQUISITION_RICH ≤ 30, EVENT ≤ 22, NOTABLE_LOT ≤ 26)
